newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Noel abandons plans for mail order firm.
newsitem.headline: Noel abandons plans for mail order firm.

text.p: Noel Gifts International Ltd said on Wednesday it would not be acquiring the stakes of major shareholders in the Heritage group of companies.
Heritage is in the mail order business where its main line of products are timepieces, jewellery and collectors' items.
Noel said in a statement the decision was the result of "a change in plans". It had originally stated in its listing prospectus dated February 1993 that it was planning to acquire the stakes.
Instead, Heritage would be wound up, the statement said.

According to the prospectus, major shareholders Alfred Wong, Ivy Tan and James Wong, who are also major shareholders in Noel, had intended to divest their interest in Heritage to Noel after Heritage had established itself.
The trio holds a total 60 percent stake in Heritage Collections Pte Ltd and Heritage Collections Ltd (HK). Alfred Wong also holds 48 percent of Heritage Collection (Thailand).
